name: AiActionApproval
title: Templates/Platform/AI/AiActionApproval
summary: A user-authorized action inside a generative AI conversation: the reader asks the assistant to deploy, the assistant records the read-only call it made (`ToolCall`), explains in `StreamingResponse` and proposes the deployment as an `ActionConfirmation` card whose title names the command in code, whose body shows the exact command in a `CodeBlock`, and whose Deny and Deploy buttons decide. Approving turns the card into Approved and adds a running `ToolCall` that completes, followed by a `ChatMessage` that reports what changed with Copy (`CopyButton`); denying or letting the request expire records the outcome on the card and the assistant says nothing ran. The `PromptInput` shows Stop while the approved action runs. Built from `Conversation`, `ChatMessage`, `ToolCall`, `StreamingResponse`, `ActionConfirmation`, `CodeBlock`, `CopyButton` and `PromptInput`.

variants.name: Irreversible
variants.summary: The assistant proposes deleting a domain nobody uses: the card turns danger and Delete stays disabled until the reader types the domain name.

variants.name: Approved
variants.summary: After Deploy: the card reads Approved, the deployment call completed, and the assistant reports the new build is live with the previous one kept for rollback.

variants.name: Denied
variants.summary: After Deny: the card reads Denied, the deployment call is recorded as denied, and the assistant acknowledges that nothing was deployed.

variants.name: Expired
variants.summary: Nobody decided in time: the card reads Request expired and the assistant says nothing was deployed.
